children: eGain reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $91.1 million, up 3% year-over-year, driven by 20% growth in AI customer revenue and AI customer ARR representing 72% of SaaS ARR. GAAP net income for the year was $8.9 million ($0.33 basic, $0.32 diluted) while adjusted EBITDA was $13.6 million (15% margin). The company was named a Leader in Gartner’s inaugural Magic Quadrant for Customer Service Knowledge Management Systems.
Total revenue for fiscal 2026: $91.1 million, up 3% from $88.4 million a year earlier.
GAAP net income for fiscal 2026: $8.9 million, or $0.33 per share basic and $0.32 diluted.
Adjusted EBITDA for fiscal 2026: $13.6 million, representing a 15% margin.
Fiscal 2026 fourth-quarter total revenue: $22.2 million; GAAP net income for Q4: $1.3 million, or $0.05 per share basic and diluted.
Total cash and cash equivalents as of June 30, 2026: $73.3 million; non-GAAP net income for fiscal 2026: $13.0 million, or $0.48 basic and $0.47 diluted.
AI customer revenue grew 20% year-over-year for the full fiscal year and 11% in the fourth quarter, signaling strong demand for the company's AI offerings.
AI customer ARR increased 13% year-over-year and represented 72% of total SaaS ARR as of June 30, 2026, highlighting AI as a growing share of recurring business.
eGain emphasized its strategic focus on "AI Knowledge" as a foundational enterprise layer to support agents, copilots and automation.
Company recognition and market momentum: named a Leader in Gartner's inaugural Magic Quadrant for Customer Service Knowledge Management Systems.
Returned capital to shareholders during the year with approximately 1,607,000 shares repurchased at an average price of $7.16, totaling $11.5 million.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: eGain Reports Fiscal 2026: Revenue $91.1M, AI Customer Revenue Up 20%
